pl-l2d30c1-d1e108.summary: States that the first man's sin and its punishment have been shown in part, not perfectly, and adds that both sin and punishment passed through him to his posterity: through one man sin entered the world, and death passed to all.
claims: Sin and punishment passed to all descendants.

pl-l2d30c1.summary: Transitions from the first man's sin and its punishment, treated in part, to the claim that both sin and punishment passed through him to his descendants, as Paul says: through one man sin entered the world, and death passed to all (Rom 5:12).
claims: Lombard's account of the first sin is partial, not complete.
Sin and punishment passed from the first man to his descendants.
